title: Chapter 1285 - 33: Magic Origin Fruit Tree
content:
Chapter 1285 - 33: Magic Origin Fruit Tree

Chapter 1285: Chapter 33: Magic Origin Fruit Tree

At the moment his avatar acted, his true self was already focused here, prepared to intervene at any moment if unexpected situations arose.

"Dimensional rift..."

Lin Yuan gazed into the vast dimensional rift.

He has always held a sense of reverence for dimensional rifts.

Within dimensional space, the rules of the great path operate, making it an ideal environment for cultivation, akin to a nurturing bed for life.

Some dimensional spaces even offer great gifts to life.

For instance, in the Chaos Void, the Origin Source infuses every life in this dimensional space with ’privileges’ that can be enjoyed.

But the dimensional rift? The rules of the great path do not exist, and one must bear the oppression emitted by vast dimensional spaces.

Creatures able to survive in the dimensional rift are very strong because the weak simply cannot withstand it.

In fact, the dimensional rift is also the battlefield for all the thirteenth-tier time lifeforms.

Thirteenth-tier time life rarely fight within dimensional space, as it causes too much damage to the dimensional space itself.

Thus, the battlefield for the thirteenth-tier is in the dimensional rift, only this vast space can endure the all-out combat among time lifeforms.

"This Magic Origin Fruit Tree?"

Lin Yuan looked at the Magic Origin Fruit Tree in his hand, his expression showing surprise, "It actually developed ’spirit’?"

Upon closer inspection, Lin Yuan keenly sensed the fluctuation of the ’spirit’ within the Magic Origin Fruit Tree itself.

He had reached out and grabbed it earlier without thinking too much, just intending to test it first.

"Master..."

The Magic Origin Fruit Tree timidly sent out a wave of consciousness.

"Quite timid."

Lin Yuan’s face revealed a smile.

He did not know that the Magic Origin Fruit Tree originally intended to devour Great Saint Feng Zhu and other supreme saints.

Of course, even if he knew, Lin Yuan wouldn’t mind too much.

Under absolute power suppression, the Magic Origin Fruit Tree couldn’t stir up much trouble.

"Take one Magic Origin Fruit, you don’t mind, do you?"

Lin Yuan gazed down at the Magic Origin Fruit Tree, speaking.

"I don’t mind, I don’t mind."

The Magic Origin Fruit Tree immediately responded, "I have many of these fruits."

After saying that.

The Magic Origin Fruit Tree’s branches and leaves swayed.

Numerous Magic Origin Fruits quickly gathered.

Dangling between the branches and leaves.

These so-called Magic Origin Fruits are merely the manifestations of the Magic Origin Fruit Tree’s aura.

Basically, they are ’bait’ used to attract other life forms.

"Alright."

Lin Yuan nodded.

He had promised the Eye of Myriad Laws to take back a Magic Origin Fruit for him.

"Those dimensional creatures..."

Lin Yuan’s gaze turned again towards that distant small continent.

Earlier, when he grabbed the Magic Origin Fruit Tree, he also wiped out many dimensional creatures on the continent.

Not like the Boundless Void, which could enhance the spiritual will.

It’s well known that within the Void Secret Realm of Boundless Void, killing those void creatures from the dimensional rift directly boosts one’s spiritual will.

"What a pity....."

Lin Yuan slightly shook his head.

He theorized two reasons.

Firstly, it’s because his spiritual will is now too high.

The enhancement in spiritual will from killing these dimensional creatures has reached a ’null effect’ for him.

Secondly, the reason why killing void creatures in the Void Secret Realm of Boundless Void enhances spiritual will is due to the unique nature of that dimensional space.

Each dimensional space has its unique traits, such as the Origin Source infusion in Chaos Void.

Lin Yuan speculated that the second reason was the most likely.

Because if it were truly effective for gaining spiritual will by killing dimensional creatures, even if it’s ineffective for him, other Great Saints would have noticed it long ago.

Even if it has little effect on the Great Saints.

Many Great Saints would surely try capturing dimensional creatures for their offspring if that were the case.

Yet, Lin Yuan had never heard of such a thing.

"Then I shall return first."

Lin Yuan packed away the Magic Origin Fruit Tree and looked at Great Saint Feng Zhu and other supreme saints.

"Alright."

Great Saint Feng Zhu immediately responded, promptly voicing.

Having witnessed the power of Lin Yuan’s avatar, the supreme saints present felt tremendous pressure.

...

Chaos Void.

The Eye of Myriad Laws looked at the Magic Origin Fruit the size of a fist in front of him, his gaze slightly excited.

"Many thanks to the Galactic Saint." The Eye of Myriad Laws looked at Lin Yuan, finding the acquisition of the Magic Origin Fruit exceedingly smooth.

The Eye of Myriad Laws had initially prepared for some complications, even with Lin Yuan, the most powerful Invincible Great Saint in history, aiding him, anything could happen in the dimensional rift; what if some mishap occurred?

Unexpectedly, Lin Yuan’s power was terrifying, and with just one avatar, he uprooted the Magic Origin Fruit Tree.

"It’s a small matter." Lin Yuan smiled and said, "I’ll just keep that Magic Origin Fruit Tree."

"Naturally."

The Eye of Myriad Laws immediately said, not asking Lin Yuan to return the Magic Origin Fruit Tree.

Because taking the Magic Origin Fruit is not the same difficulty as taking the whole tree.

The dimensional creatures on that small continent were fiercely guarding the Magic Origin Fruit Tree.

If only one Magic Origin Fruit were taken, it might not provoke the ferocity of those dimensional creatures.

But to take the whole tree? All the dimensional creatures on the small continent would probably fight desperately.

In this scenario, even in the Eye of Myriad Laws’ initial predictions, even Lin Yuan might not withstand it.

Taking a single Magic Origin Fruit might still allow for a safe retreat.

Taking a whole Magic Origin Fruit Tree significantly reduces the chance of a safe retreat.

The Eye of Myriad Laws was only interested in the Magic Origin Fruit and naturally did not want to take such a big risk.

"In that case, I’ll be going back first."

Lin Yuan stood up, ready to leave.

"Alright."

The Eye of Myriad Laws looked at Lin Yuan: "The evolutionary path branch of the Great Saint of the Galaxy is spreading very smoothly at the moment, and even if the Great Saint falls into a time loop, it will continue to spread with me around."

"Thank you."

Lin Yuan smiled upon hearing this.

After falling into a time loop, continuing to spread one’s evolutionary path branch is certainly beneficial for anchoring the ’anchor.’

This statement by the Eye of Myriad Laws was also an attempt to curry favor with Lin Yuan.

"It’s nothing."

The Eye of Myriad Laws immediately said, "With the foundations of the Great Saint of the Galaxy, even without spreading the evolutionary path branch, reaching the thirteenth stage wouldn’t be difficult."

This was indeed the heartfelt words of the Eye of Myriad Laws.

The vast Chaos Void has birthed many thirteenth-stage time beings.

But Lin Yuan? Since the opening of the Chaos Void, there’s only been one such being.

There has been none before.

And likely none to come.

The existence of Lin Yuan is even rarer than a thirteenth-stage time being.

"It still needs to be spread."

Lin Yuan smiled, then his figure disappeared.

The Eye of Myriad Laws looked at where Lin Yuan vanished.

Falling into contemplation.

At this moment, he faintly regretted.

Had he asked too early?

...

Desolate Void.

Lin Yuan’s true self sat cross-legged.

At this moment, an avatar appeared.

"Not only understanding cause and effect this time, but also gaining something?"

A smile appeared on Lin Yuan’s face as he extended his right hand, with the Magic Origin Fruit Tree appearing between his palms.

In fact, the so-called Magic Origin Fruit is merely ’bait’ casually condensed by the Magic Origin Fruit Tree with its breath.

The most precious is still the Magic Origin Fruit itself.

"My lord..."

The Magic Origin Fruit Tree was almost suffocated, experiencing a journey from heaven to hell again, from Lin Yuan’s avatar to his true self.

Compared to the avatar, Lin Yuan’s true self gave it a much stronger sense of oppression.

"Put it into the internal universe."

Lin Yuan slightly moved his thoughts, and the Magic Origin Fruit Tree was transferred to the internal universe.

These rare wonders born from dimensional gaps also have a certain degree of feedback effect on the internal universe.

At least stronger than the Chaos Tree.

Buzz～

The Magic Origin Fruit Tree hadn’t yet reacted.

It found itself in a boundless universe.

"This should be my lord’s internal universe..." thought the Magic Origin Fruit Tree.

It had interacted with Great Saint Feng Zhu and other unparalleled Great Saints, knowing about the internal universe.

"No."

"My lord’s internal universe?"

The Magic Origin Fruit Tree just sighed in relief, thinking Lin Yuan putting it into the internal universe showed no malice.

But immediately, the Magic Origin Fruit Tree realized something was off.

"This internal universe? This internal universe?"

The Magic Origin Fruit Tree was incredulous, "Perfect, so perfect, more perfect than this dimensional space?"

Drifting in the dimensional gap, having come into contact with many dimensional spaces, the largest being the Chaos Void.

Yet at this moment, in the Magic Origin Fruit Tree’s perception, even the vast Chaos Void couldn’t compare to Lin Yuan’s internal universe?
